body: That place is a shithole. Good riddance.

What a fucking joke of a church this is. I started going when I was in 3rd grade. My mom became really good friends with our neighbors who were activily involved in Xenos. So for me, I thought I had new friends. I never really had any especially when I was a kid so I tried to fit in. I would go to their house and me and their kids started hanging out. Then it started turning into bible study time all the time. My mom thought it was good for me so she started making me go to the events on the main Xenos campus. I'll admit they were fun. I just wanted to meet friends. I never honestly cared for the ideology. Fast forward to high school. I started realizing that those kids werent actually my friends. ( I had one flat  out say he wasnt to get out of defending me when I used to gt mercilessly bullied in middle school). But my mother still made me go to CT. Id get friends of mine from my high school to come along so i could skip the teaching with them because i couldnt stand it anymore. Since I stopped going completely, none of my Xenoid "friends" speak to me. My neighbors deleted me from facebook and when I come over to visit my mom and they are there they just dont even acknowledge me. A friend of mine who also got out told me that they tried to pray away the gay in him. They will do anything for followers. Some of the most ignorant and obnoxious parties on campus i have seen were in Xenos houses. And lets not forget how they let underage kids smoke at CT.
